claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount additive ability modifier term for reduce_damage_taken
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The core reaction reduces damage by a die roll plus Dexterity modifier. `reduce_damage_taken.amount` currently accepts `DiceAmount`, but `DiceExpr` can only add a flat number or spellcasting modifier, not a general ability modifier.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation or equipment predicate for free hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction is only available if the wearer has a free hand. Existing item predicates cover wearing, holding, armor, and weapon states, but not an open-hand requirement.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: catch_incoming_missile
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Reducing the hit to 0 can convert the intercepted ammunition or thrown weapon into a held object. That object-capture rider is deterministic item-state transfer, not just flavor, and no current effect atom models it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon if it is small enough for you to hold in that hand."
